newsitem.title: UK: Reckitt gains on renewed bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Reckitt gains on renewed bid talk.

text.p: Shares in Reckitt & Colman Plc rose in pre-market trade on Wednesday as Unilever Plc's sale of its speciality chemicals arm to ICI revived bid talk around the household products group, dealers said.
Reckitt shares were up 26p at 898-1/2 by 0714 GMT in volume of 29,000 shares.

"Obviously people are putting two and two together and asking what Unilever will be looking at," said one dealer. "They have a $5 billion profit from the sale and they will be looking to spend it somewhere."

Speculation that Reckitt could be a target for Unilever has swirled since the Anglo-Dutch chemicals giant put its speciality chemicals arm up for sale earlier this year, saying it wanted to focus on expanding its consumer goods operations particularly in developing markets.
